PcosDiagnosis.6: Kuongororwa kwePCOS, kuongororwa kupi kungaitwa, uye kugadzirira nguva yako zvakanaka.
PcosDiagnosis.15: Kuongororwa kwepolycystic ovary syndrome hakushandisi bvunzo imwe chete. nyanzvi yezvokurapa inounganidza mashoko akawanda: nhoroondo yako yemhedzisiro, zviratidzo, kuongororwa kwekiriniki, kuongororwa kwema laboratori, uye, zvichienderana nemamiriro ezvinhu, kuongorora kwechidzitiro.
PcosDiagnosis.16: Chinangwa chacho ndechokutsvaka zvinhu zvinoenderana nePCOS uye kubvisa zvimwe zvikonzero zvingaita kuti nguva dzisati dzatanga kana kuti zvimwe zviratidzo zvehomoni.
PcosDiagnosis.18: Kuongororwa kunogara kuri kwevanhu vose. Vakadzi vaviri vane PCOS vanogona kuva nezviratidzo zvakasiyana zvikuru uye miedzo inogona kuitika.
PcosDiagnosis.19: Basa racho rinogona kutevera matanho akati wandei.
PcosDiagnosis.21: Nyanzvi yacho inounganidza nhoroondo yako: kutenderera, zviratidzo, ruzivo rwokurapa, uye marapirwo.
PcosDiagnosis.23: Vanotarisa kunyanya kana paine zviratidzo zvekuwedzera kweandrogens uye vanoongorora mamiriro ako ezvinhu.
PcosDiagnosis.25: Kuongorora kwehomoni uye kuongorora kwemagetsi kunogona kukumbirwa kuti kujekeswe mamiriro ezvinhu.
PcosDiagnosis.27: Inogona kupedzisa basa racho nokucherechedza kuoneka kwemazai.
PcosDiagnosis.33: Kuongororwa kweropa kunogona kupiwa kuti uone kana paine androgens yakawanda, uone mamwe mahormone anobatsira pakuzvara, uye uone zvimwe zvinogona kukonzera zviratidzo zvako.
PcosDiagnosis.34: Kuongororwa kwaunosarudza kunoenderana nezera rako, zviratidzo zvako, nhoroondo yako yeutano, uye zvauri kutsvaka kuongororwa nachiremba.
PcosDiagnosis.36: Testosterone uye mamwe mahormone zvichienderana nemamiriro ezvinhu.
PcosDiagnosis.38: Kunobatsira zvikurukuru kubvisa zvimwe zvikonzero zvenguva dzisina kururama.
PcosDiagnosis.40: Glucose muropa, dzimwe nguva pane lipid panel zvichienderana nezvinhu zvinokuvadza.
PcosDiagnosis.42: Mhedzisiro yemahomoni inofanira kududzirwa pamwe chete nemhedzisiro yekiriniki. kukosha kumwe chete hakusi kukwana, pachako, kupedzisa chirwere chePCOS.
PcosDiagnosis.43: Ultrasound inogona kushandiswa kuona kuoneka kwemapfupa omuviri uye kunyanya kutsvaka nhamba huru yemapfupa maduku.
PcosDiagnosis.45: Kuona mafolicle akawanda pa ultrasound hakurevi kuti une PCOS.
PcosDiagnosis.46: Kuwana chirwere chePCOS hakugoni kuita kuti munhu afunge kuti zvinhu zvichafamba sei.
PcosDiagnosis.49: Kuongororwa chete hakusi ndiko kunoratidza kurapwa.
PcosDiagnosis.50: Kuongorora kwemazuva ose hakuiti kuti PCOS isarambe iripo.
PcosDiagnosis.51: Mashoko mashomanana akagadzirirwa nguva isati yakwana anogona kubatsira nyanzvi yacho kunzwisisa nhoroondo yako uye kusarudza miedzo yakakodzera.
PcosDiagnosis.53: Wakamboona here kuti une makonzo, bvudzi rakakura zvisingawanzoitiki, kana kuti bvudzi rinodonha?
PcosDiagnosis.54: Pane nhoroondo yemhuri yePCOS kana kuti chirwere cheshuga here?
PcosDiagnosis.55: Unoda kuva nepamuviri munguva pfupi here kana kuti yepakati?
PcosDiagnosis.57: Kana zvichibvira, nyora mazuva awakava nenguva yako yokupedzisira, nguva yawakagara uchitenderera, zviratidzo zvauri kuona, uye kurapwa kupi nokupi kana kuti zvokuwedzera zvauri kutora.
PcosDiagnosis.59: Kuongororwa kunobva pazvinhu zvakawanda, kwete bvunzo imwe chete.
PcosDiagnosis.60: Kuongororwa kweropa kunogona kutsvaka zvimwe zvinokonzera kusarura kwemahomoni uye kungasatungamirira kune zvimwe zvikonzero.
PcosDiagnosis.61: Ultrasound inogona kupedza basa racho zvichienderana nemamiriro ezvinhu.
PcosDiagnosis.62: Mhedzisiro yacho inofanira kugara ichitsanangurwa nenyanzvi yezvokurapa.
PcosDiagnosis.64: Kuongorora PCOS hakusi kuongorora kamwe chete kana kuti kutonga kwekupedzisira. Kunokubatsira kunzwisisa kushanda kwehomoni yako, kutsvaka zvimwe zvikonzero zvinogona kukonzera uye kuvaka utano hunoenderana nemamiriro ako ezvinhu.
PcosDiagnosis.65: Nyaya ino inoitira mashoko chete uye haitsivi kubvunza kwaunoita chiremba kana kuti kududzirwa kwemigumisiro yako.

PcosHormonalAcne.6: Nei mahomoni achibvunda achigona kuoneka nePCOS, kuti ungazviziva sei, uye ndezvipi zvingabatsira kuichirapa.

PcosHormonalAcne.17: Hormonal acne chimiro cheacne chinobatanidzwa zvakananga nekuchinja kwehomoni kana kusagadzikana, kunyanya muandrogens. Kusiyana neakajairika acne yevechidiki, inowanzoitika kuvakadzi vakuru uye inogona kuramba kana kuoneka mushure menguva iyoyo.
PcosHormonalAcne.18: Rinozivikanwawo nenzvimbo yaro, kudzika kwayo, uye muitiro wayo wokudzoka munzvimbo imwe cheteyo pasinei nokutevedzera zvakanaka tsika yokutarisira ganda nguva dzose.
PcosHormonalAcne.20: Kuita kuti chiso chimboputika hakunei nokushaya utsanana: kushambidza chiso kakawanda hakusi kuita kuti chiso chimboputika, uye kunogona kutoita kuti ganda rako rive rakaoma.
PcosHormonalAcne.22: MuPCOS, kuwanda kweandrogen kunokurudzira maronda e sebaceous, ayo anozoita kuti pave nechirwere che sebum.

PcosHormonalAcne.28: Kazhinji kacho inoonekazve panzvimbo imwe chete
PcosHormonalAcne.29: Kupisa kana kuti zviratidzo zvinoramba zviripo
PcosHormonalAcne.30: Kuita kuti munhu ave nechirwere chemabhonzo uye kutenderera kwemwedzi
PcosHormonalAcne.31: Mahomoni ane zvekuita nemapfupa anogona kuchinja-chinja panguva yose yavanenge vachidzokera kumwedzi.
PcosHormonalAcne.33: Kuziva kuti nguva ipi yaunopinda nayo munhoroondo yako kunogona kukubatsira iwe nechiremba wako kuti munzwisise zviri nani kuti zvinokonzerwa nekushaya ropa zvakadini.
PcosHormonalAcne.35: Zvinhu zvishomanana zviri nyore zvinogona kubatsira kuti urege kupenga, asi usingazvibvisi zvachose:
PcosHormonalAcne.37: Dzivisa zvigadzirwa zvakaoma kana kuti zvinobvisa
PcosHormonalAcne.40: Zvichienderana nemamiriro ezvinhu, chiremba weropa kana kuti wezvokurapa kwevakadzi anogona kukurudzira kurapwa kwese kwese (makirimu, majeli) kana kuti, kana zvichidiwa, kurapwa kwakakodzera kwemahomoni.
PcosHormonalAcne.42: Kurapwa kwehomoni (kwepanyama kana kuti kwehomoni) kunofanira kurayirwa uye kuongororwa nenyanzvi yezvokurapa, kunyanya kana uri kutarisira kubata pamuviri.
PcosHormonalAcne.44: Mazano ekurapa anobatsira zvikuru mune zvimwe zviitiko:
PcosHormonalAcne.45: Acne inoramba iripo pasinei nokuti inochengetwa zvakanaka
PcosHormonalAcne.47: Akne yakakura kana kuti acne inowedzera kukurumidza
PcosHormonalAcne.51: Kuzvimba kwehomoni kune chikonzero chinonyatsozivikanwa, chinobatanidzwa nemagenes.
PcosHormonalAcne.52: Kazhinji rinokanganisa rutivi rutsva rwechiso uye rinogona kuwedzera kuipa nguva isati yasvika.
PcosHormonalAcne.53: Haisi kushomeka kwokuchena kana kuti kusafanira.
PcosHormonalAcne.54: Kutarisira kwakanaka uye, kana zvichidiwa, kurapwa kwakakodzera kunogona kuvandudza.
PcosHormonalAcne.55: Chiremba wezvematongerwo enyika kana kuti chiremba wezvemadzimai anogona kukubatsira kana ukaramba uchirwara.
PcosHormonalAcne.57: Nyaya ino inoitira kuti vanhu vawane mashoko akawanda uye haisi yokutsiva kubvunza chiremba.

PcosIntro.87: PCOS inodzivisa kubata pamuviri nguva dzose: ovulation inogona kunge isina kurongeka, asi kubata pamuviri kuchiri kuitika.
PcosIntro.88: Chiratidzo chimwe chete chinokwana kuti munhu azive PCOS: chirwere ichi chinoda kuongororwa kwakazara.
PcosIntro.89: PCOS inongopera nezera: maratidziro ayo anogona kuchinja muupenyu, asi kutevera nguva dzose kunoramba kuchikosha.
PcosIntro.91: Mazano echiremba anokosha zvikuru kana nguva dzokufamba kwemwedzi dzisingaenderani, dzomira kwemwedzi yakati kuti, kana kuti kana zviratidzo zvisingawanzoitiki zvikaoneka.

PcosIntro.105: Nzira yokurapa yakasarudzwa inobatsira kusangana nezvinodiwa nomukadzi mumwe nomumwe.

PcosLifestyleManagement.6: Zvaungaita kuti urarame nePCOS, uye tsika dzakareruka dzingakutsigira muupenyu hwako hwezuva nezuva.
PcosLifestyleManagement.13: Zviratidzo zvinoda kuti munhu akurumidze kuzviona
PcosLifestyleManagement.16: Ipa zvokudya zvako kuti usava nenzara
PcosLifestyleManagement.17: Dzivisa shuga dzinokurumidza uye zvokudya zvakanyatsogadzirwa
PcosLifestyleManagement.18: Hapana zvokudya zvinorambidzwa: chinangwa chokuenzanisa zvinhu zvose pane kuti zvive mitemo yakaoma
PcosLifestyleManagement.19: Hapana kurapwa kumwe chete kwePCOS: kurapwa kunoenderana nezviratidzo zvako, zvaunokoshesa (kutenderera, kubereka, ganda, uremu), uye mamiriro ako ezvinhu.
PcosLifestyleManagement.20: Kuita basa rokurovedza muviri nguva dzose, kunyange rakakwirira (kufamba nokukurumidza, kuchovha bhasikoro, kudzidziswa nesimba) kunobatsira kutsigira kuenzanisa kwemahomoni uye kuenzanisa zvinhu.
PcosLifestyleManagement.21: Kurara zvakakwana uye kugara uchizorora kunobatsira kudzikamisa kukanganiswa kwehomoni, izvo zvinogona kukanganisa zviratidzo zvePCOS.
PcosLifestyleManagement.23: Kuchinja kuduku, kunogara kwenguva refu kunowanzobudirira kupfuura kuchinja kukuru kunonetsa kuchengeta.
PcosLifestyleManagement.24: Kurarama nePCOS kunogona kukanganisa mafungiro ako, kunyanya nemhaka yezviratidzo zvinooneka kana kuti kunetseka nezvokubereka.
PcosLifestyleManagement.26: Kurwadziwa kwakanyanya kana kuti kusingawanzoitiki muzvigunwe zvemusoro, kubuda ropa kwakanyanya kana kuti kwenguva yakareba, kuneta kwakanyanya kana kuti nyota isingawanzoitiki, kana kuti kushushikana mupfungwa kunogadzikana nekufamba kwenguva.
PcosLifestyleManagement.28: PCOS inodzorwa zuva nezuva nemararamiro akareruka uye kugara uchitevera chiremba: kuchinja kwose kunokosha, zvichienderana nezvaunoda.

PcosMetabolism.15: Insulin ihormone inobatsira masero kuti ashandise glucose muropa. Kana masero asingashandisi insulin, haapinduri zvakanaka nehormone iyi, uye muviri unogona kuikurira nokuita kuti uwedzere insulin.
PcosMetabolism.16: MuPCOS, izvi zvinogona kuwirirana nekuwedzera kweandrogen kugadzirwa uye zvinogona kukonzera zvimwe zviratidzo. Asi havasi vakadzi vose vane PCOS vane chimiro chimwe chete chemagetsi.
